Vercel agent-desktop v1.0.2, Apache-2.0.

https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/releases/tag/v1.0.2

The optional native driver is shipped in the Windows development bundle.
Archive SHA-256 is pinned in scripts/package_windows.py. No upstream runtime
source is copied. The adapter supports JSON contract 2.5, observes the selected
window, and records durable Aksara intents before native actions. The driver is
not a sandbox, identity provider or authority grant.
